lines.text: Marco's first snowy hike started great.
Ten minutes in, snow was spilling over the tops of his boots.
It melted into his socks, and his toes went numb.
Here's the fix. Pull leg gaiters on over your laces before you reach the snow.
The strap runs under your sole,
the gaiter covers you up to mid-calf,
and snow slides off instead of falling in.
Marco finished the loop with dry socks.
Save this before your first snow hike.
